name: tr_dray
caption:
IF DRAYMOND HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

💪 Machop: it trains all day and is never satisfied. 34 players went before him, we took him at #35
🧱 Shuckle: its ability is Sturdy, and it hides in a hard shell. 2017 Defensive Player of the Year, and the steals leader
🧠 Metagross: four brains, smarter than a supercomputer. 7.6 assists a night in his first 9 games
🐒 Primeape: always furious, and it never forgives. 16 technicals in one season
❤️ Conkeldurr: said to have taught humans to make concrete. Our heart and soul, 4 rings, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2022
🏋️ Machamp: four arms, so it attacks and defends at once. 36 years old, started all 9 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Draymond Green had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF DRAYMOND HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Machop. It trains hard all day and is never satisfied. Thirty-four players went before him. We took him thirty-fifth.
beats.dlg: IT TRAINS ALL DAY LONG.|34 PASSED. WE TOOK HIM #35

beats.vo: Shuckle. Its ability is Sturdy, and it hides inside a hard shell. Defensive Player of the Year in twenty seventeen, and he led the league in steals.
beats.dlg: STURDY, IN A HARD SHELL.|2017 DEFENSIVE POY!

beats.vo: Metagross. Four brains, smarter than a supercomputer. He still runs our offense: seven point six assists a night in his first nine games.
beats.dlg: A SUPERCOMPUTER BRAIN.|7.6 ASSISTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: Primeape. It's always furious, and it never forgives. Sixteen technicals in one season. We love him anyway.
beats.dlg: ALWAYS FURIOUS.|16 TECHS IN ONE SEASON!

beats.vo: Conkeldurr. It's said to have taught humans how to make concrete. Our foundation, our heart and soul. Four rings with us.
And the ace. Machamp. With four arms, it attacks and defends at the same time. Thirty-six years old, and he's started all nine games.
beats.dlg: ATTACKS + DEFENDS AT ONCE.|AGE 36: 9 OF 9 STARTS!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Green: drafted 35th overall (2nd round) in 2012 by Golden State, 34 players before him; 2017 Defensive Player of the Year and NBA steals leader (2017); March 16, 2023: suspended for his 16th technical foul of the season; emotional heart and soul of the Warriors, noted for vocal leadership; 4x NBA champion (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022); born March 4, 1990 (age 36)
